NOTICE INVITING TENDER Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (IIITM) in Gwalior, M adhya Pradesh is an autonomous institute of National Importance set by the Gov ernment of India, MHRD (Presently Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) in 1997. I t is an effort by MHRD (Presently Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) to create p rofessionals in the areas of management and information technology from the sa me institute. This institute was created to facilitate higher education, research, a nd consultancy in the areas of information technology (IT) and business manage ment. Initially known as IIITM, the institute was prefixed with ABV in 2002 to hon our the then Prime Minister, Atal Bihari Vajpayee.The Institute intends to procure 2U Rack Servers (Quantity: 02 Nos.) in the Institute. The Institute Invites Bids/Tenders from various organisations/vendors for the abo ve-mentioned work. Introduction Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (AB V-IIITM), Gwalior, invites bids for the supply, installation, commissioning, and warrant y of 02 Rack Mountable servers. The selected vendor (Bidder/OEM) shall be responsi ble for delivering a fully functional, configured, and ready-to-use system at the desig nated location, along with onsite warranty and maintenance services for hardware an d software-related problems. 2. Scope of Work for Supply 2.1. The bidder/OEM shall furnish Servers and associated accessories (e.g., keyboard , mouse, power cords) as specified in accordance with the Schedule of Requirem ents provided in Annexure-A and the Technical Specifications detailed in Annexur e-B. 2.2. All equipment supplied must be brand new, fully functional, and operable, confo rming to the specifications and requirements of this tender. No refurbished or en d-of-life products will be accepted. 2.3. The bidder/OEM shall be responsible for the supply, delivery, installation, testing , commissioning, and basic user handover at the locations specified by ABV-IIITM Gwalior. 2.4 The work shall be executed on a turnkey basis, which means that all components , accessories, cables, and necessary items for making the servers fully operation al shall be supplied and installed within the quoted price. 2.5 All items supplied under this tender — including rack mountable servers and bun dled accessories shall carry an onsite OEM warranty for a period of three (3) year s from the date of successful installation and acceptance by the institute. 2.6 During the warranty period, the vendor shall provide maintenance services for an y hardware and software-related problems, ensuring minimum downtime and pro mpt resolution. Support must include hardware repairs/replacement and software -level assistance for pre-installed OS and basic utilities. 2.7 The vendor must ensure that all required components are integrated and configu red correctly. This includes, but is not limited to, BIOS setup, operating system ac tivation, driver installation, and network configuration, as required. 2.8 The vendor shall provide relevant documents, including OEM warranty certificate , OS license details, installation checklist, and equipment serial number list at the time of delivery and acceptance. 3. Scope of Work for Installation and Commissioning 3.1. The bidder/OEM shall carry out installation and commissioning of the supplied sy stems at the designated site within the specified time frame.

3.2. The bidder/OEM shall maintain the cleanliness of the site and ensure the remova l of all packaging and installation waste from the work site. 3.3. All required tools and materials for installation shall be arranged by the bidder/O EM at their own cost. 3.4 Any damage caused to the property of Tenderer while executing the job shall be solely Bidder/OEM/Vendor's responsibility. In case any damage to the property is caused, the same will be recovered from the Bidder/OEM/Vendors. No extra cost shall be paid to the Bidder/OEM/Vendor for such reasons. 3.5 Bidder/ OEM shall install and configure all the necessary software including syste ms software (e.g. OS, drivers, etc). 3.6 All systems shall be tested for functional verification in the presence of institute r epresentatives. 4. Inspection and Testing 4.1 The successful bidder shall be responsible for obtaining the installation and com missioning certificate (sign-off) upon completion of the work, in accordance with t he scope of work and technical requirements. 4.2 The Successful bidder shall be responsible for the rectification of discrepancies id entified by the TPA/any other authorised representative while conducting SAT (Si te Acceptance Testing). Further on rectification of all the discrepancies identified during the SAT, TENDERER/ABV-IIITM representatives will re-conduct the SAT, or i f agreed, the SAT will be signed. 4.3 The warranty and OEM support shall commence only after the installation and for mal acceptance by the department. 4.4 During the warranty period, the bidder shall maintain the systems and repair or replace all defective components at the installation site, free of cost. All defectiv e components that are brought to the bidder's notice. 4.5 As far as possible, the bidder shall attempt to repair/replace the defective equip ment onsite. 4.6 The bidder shall ensure that the warranty services comply with the technical sta ndards, security requirements, operating procedures, and recovery procedures a greed upon. 5. Selection Criteria of OEM 5.1 All products quoted must be listed on the global website of the respective OEM. 5.2 The bid must include a Manufacturer Authorisation Form or a Registered/Authoris ed Partner Certificate from the OEM of the servers. 6. Maintenance of Services 6.1 The bidder shall ensure the repairing/replacement of all faulty material within the shortest possible time, thus ensuring minimum downtime, failing which an applic able penalty may be imposed. 6.2 If any equipment gives continuous trouble (e.g., three failures in a single month) , the bidder shall replace the hardware at no additional cost to the purchaser.

7. Instructions to bidders 7.1 The supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of the servers must be comp leted within 60 days from the date of the confirmed purchase order. Bidders mus t confirm acceptance of this schedule in the Technical Bid. 7.2 Bidder must ensure that the warranty support & service should be available up t o delivery locations to provide repairing cum replacement services of faulty equi pment within 72 hrs. Bidder is required to provide the escalation matrix and nam e & address & contact details of the concerned firm/person for providing warrant y support & repairing cum replacement service up to delivery locations. 7.3 Free maintenance services shall be provided by the Bidder during the period of warranty. 7.4 If the bidder fails to provide satisfactory support or causes unwarranted delays, ABV-IIITM reserves the right to repair the equipment at the risk and cost of the bi dder. 8. Penalty Clause 8.1 Penalties for delay in delivery and installation attributable to the bidder/vendor/O EM: If the bidder fails to deliver and install the requisite devices or software withi n the time limit, then a sum equivalent to 0.5% of the contract Value shall be de ducted from the payment for each calendar week of delay or part thereof, subjec t to a maximum limit of 5% of the total contract value. 8.2 Delay in excess of 6 weeks will be sufficient to cause termination of the contract . In that case, the Performance Bank Guarantee of the bidder will be forfeited. 8.3 In case, the selected bidder does not supply the ordered items for any reason, h e will be liable to pay the difference amount to the purchaser, over and above th e Performance Guarantee. 9. Operational / Warranty period Penalties: During the warranty period, if the complaint is not resolved within 72 hrs, the pen alty of Rs. 1000 per day for the Server will be levied. However, if the complaints are not resolved within 7 days, then from the 8th day to the 14th day, a penalty would be levied @ 1500 Rs and from the 15th day onwards, a penalty of Rs 3000 would be levied. The amount of the penalty will be recovered from the Performa nce bank guarantee during the warranty period. 10. Arbitration 10.1 If a dispute of any kind whatsoever arises between the ABV-IIITM and the ve ndor in connection with, or arising out of, the Contract or the execution of the works or after their completion and whether before or after the repudiation or other termination of the contract, including any disagreement by either party with any action, in action, opinion, instruction, determination, certificate or val uation of the Engineer, the matter in dispute shall be settled by arbitration in a ccordance with the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 or any statuto ry amendment thereof. 10.2 The reference to arbitration may proceed notwithstanding that the works sha ll not then be or be alleged to be completed, provided always that the obligati ons of the ABV-IIITM, Gwalior and the Bidder shall not be altered by reason of t he arbitration being conducted during the progress of the works. Neither party

shall be entitled to suspend the works; payments to the Bidder shall continue t o be made as provided by the contract. 10.3 Arbitration proceedings shall be held at Gwalior and the language of the arbit ration proceedings and that of all documents and communications between th e parties shall be English. 10.4 All arbitration awards shall be in writing and shall state the reasons for the a ward. 10.5 Penalty/Liquidated Damages shall not fall under the Arbitration clause. 10.6 Terms and Conditions for submission of Bids 10.7 The competent authority of the Institute has every right to extend the due da te of tender if so required, but all the Bids/tenders will be opened together. 10.8 Deduction of T.D.S will be made as per Government rules. 10.9 Bids/Tenders deviating from the above terms and Conditions will be rejected straight away without assigning any reason thereof. 10.10 All disputes are subject to the Jurisdiction of the Gwalior court only. 10.11 The Institute has the right to reject any or all quotations/Tenders without assi gning any reason.
